init_distributed: initialize the distributed environment and return rank, world size, and whether distributed mode is active
spawn_mock_workers: spawn N local worker processes for testing distributed execution without a SLURM cluster
ZmqQueueServer: create a server-side ZMQ queue that sends tasks to workers and receives results from them
DistributedWorker: run a standalone distributed worker that pulls tasks from ZMQ and executes ContributorAgent jobs concurrently
DistributedTask: create a serializable task dataclass with task ID, agent type, worktree path, and branch name
